description: Implementation of ReadReportingService for generating and retrieving reports in CSV, PDF, and other formats within the Fineract infrastructure. Handles SQL query generation, report data retrieval, and report file creation.

classes.name: ReadReportingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing report retrieval and generation functionalities, including CSV and PDF report creation, with SQL query handling and report data processing.

classes.name: ReportParameterJoinMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to ReportParameterJoinData objects.

classes.name: ReportParameterMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to ReportParameterData objects.

methods.name: retrieveReportCSV
methods.description: Generates CSV report output stream for a given report.

methods.name: generateCsvFileBuffer
methods.description: Writes report data into CSV format in the provided output stream.

methods.name: retrieveGenericResultset
methods.description: Retrieves report data as a generic result set based on report name, type, and parameters.

methods.name: getSQLtoRun
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query to execute for report data retrieval, replacing placeholders with parameters.

methods.name: getSql
methods.description: Fetches the SQL statement for a report based on its name and type, ensuring security and validation.

methods.name: getQuotedTableName
methods.description: Returns a safely quoted table name for a report type.

methods.name: getQuotedColumnName
methods.description: Returns a safely quoted column name based on report type and suffix.

methods.name: getReportType
methods.description: Retrieves the report type for a given report name.

methods.name: retrieveReportPDF
methods.description: Generates a PDF report file for a given report.

methods.name: retrieveReports
methods.description: Internal method to fetch reports and their parameters, optionally filtered by ID.

methods.name: getAllowedParameters
methods.description: Returns list of permitted report parameters.

methods.name: retrieveGenericResultSetForSmsEmailCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves report data formatted for SMS/Email campaigns.

methods.name: sqlToRunForSmsEmailCampaign
methods.description: Constructs SQL for SMS/Email campaign report.

methods.name: generatePentahoReportAsOutputStream
methods.description: Placeholder for generating reports via Pentaho; currently unimplemented.
